# Hostinger

Web hosting and domain management platform with APIs for billing, domains, DNS, and VPS management

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hostinger/.

## Actions

- **Check Domain Availability** (read-only): Check domain availability.
- **Get DNS Records** (read-only): Retrieve DNS records for a domain.
- **List Catalog Items** (read-only): Get catalog item list.
- **List Domains** (read-only): Get domain list.
- **List Hosting Orders** (read-only): List hosting orders.
- **List Payment Methods** (read-only): Get payment method list.
- **List Public Keys** (read-only): Get public keys.
- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): Get subscription list.
- **List Virtual Machines** (read-only): Get virtual machines.
- **List Websites** (read-only): List websites.
- **Create VPS Public Key**: Create public key.
- **Create WHOIS Profile**: Create a WHOIS contact profile for domain registration.
- **Delete Public Key**: Delete public key.
- **Generate Free Subdomain**: Generate a free subdomain.
- **Get Domain Forwarding** (read-only): Retrieve domain forwarding configuration.
- **Get VPS Template Details** (read-only): Get template details.
- **Get WHOIS Profile** (read-only): Get WHOIS profile.
- **Get WHOIS Profile Usage** (read-only): Retrieve domain list where provided WHOIS contact profile is used.
- **List DNS Snapshots** (read-only): Retrieve DNS snapshots for a domain.
- **List VPS Data Centers** (read-only): Get data center list.
- **List VPS Templates** (read-only): Get templates.
- **List WHOIS Profiles** (read-only): Retrieve WHOIS contact profiles for domain registration.
- **Validate DNS Records** (read-only): Validate DNS records.
- **Verify Domain Ownership** (read-only): Verify ownership of a single domain and return the verification status.
